         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM commerce.sales AS s

         LAG(m.revenue) OVER (ORDER BY m.month) AS prev_revenue

)

       r.revenue - r.prev_revenue AS revenue_change
FROM ranked AS r
